answer: An copycat hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 27 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The willow counter is kept in umber and lotus shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 27 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2218 identities would post 2143 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
